positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Yonkers, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
* Built backend buisness logic, API endpoints and database integrations for a custom application to facilitate buisness processes. 
* Designed and implemented frontend interface to interact with backend and perform data validation. 
* Used defensive coding techniques to protect the backend and frontend from attack. 
* Tracked changes using git version control.
* Used docker to containerize the application and facilitate deployment. 
* Communicated with stakeholders to ensure the feautes and application meets buisness needs. 
* Used debugging principles and concepts to track errors and improve code quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Bash · Creative Problem Solving · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · IT Automation · Programming · Shell Scripting · Software Troubleshooting · Python (Programming Language) · Front-end Coding · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · JSON · Back-End Web Development · Flask · FastAPI

positions.title: Desktop Support Technician
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
● As part of a technical support team provides support to users by troubleshooting hardware, software and firmware issues. 
● Performed IT matenance and troubleshooting by Installing drivers, hardware and accessories on computers according to schedule or as requested by users (following security protocols).
● Configures and troubleshoots print devices on the the print server. 
● Performed troubleshooting for malfunctioning printers. 
● Reimaged errant or malicious devices. 
● Used command line troubleshoot devices, correct networking erros or to force compliance with group policy.
● enrolled devices in Mobile device management system
● troubleshoots, updates and supports mobile devices (smartphones and tablets) used by staff. 
● Worked with the networking team to connect devices to their respective switches for configuration. 
● Used bomgar, microsoft teams and teamviewer for the remote support of staff. Worked with password managers to control user access to the organization network.
● Troubleshoots, debugs and proficiently uses microsoft office applications including but not limited to: microsoft word, microsoft outlook, microsoft teams, microsoft powerpoint, microsoft excel.
● Setups and troubleshoots conferences with staff and remote conferences.
● Uses Service Desk ticket system. Manages tickets, makes reports and enters asset data into service desk.
positions.insights: Skills: Ticketing Systems · Help Desk Support · Mobile Device Troubleshooting · Computer Science · Cybersecurity · Information Technology · Password Resets · Peripherals · Printer Support · Communication · Technical Support · Operating Systems · System Performance · Troubleshooting · ServiceNow · Remote User Support · Computer Engineering · Problem Solving · Software Troubleshooting

positions.title: Exterminator
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
● As part of the federal monitor initiative, vacuum cleaned tenants apartments to remove frass. Sealed cracks and crevices using caulking and other elastomeric materials. Applied pesticides as needed to control insects and vertebrates. 
● Managed properties for Norway rats in gardens, crawl spaces, under concrete slabs, compactor rooms and in basements using tracking powder, soft baits, bait blocks and other available rodent control technologies.
● Implemented IPM practices to successfully control pests. In commercial and residential. 
● Set appointments, educated clients and provided customer service in English, Spanish & Portuguese. 
● Mixed restricted use pesticides within the parameters of the labels for application.
positions.insights: Skills: Integrated Pest Management · Communication · Property Inspections · Troubleshooting · Visual Inspection · Government · Problem Solving

positions.title: Exterminator
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
● Worked in various Jail facilities throughout NYC. These facilities include but are not limited to: Trailers, Grounds, Jail facilities, Bakery, mechanic shops, machine shops
● Work included but was not limited pest control services by means of IPM practices, interviewing inmates, inspecting for wildlife and pest control related cleaning services (cadavers, frass, etc). 
Performed treatments for bed bugs, silverfish, book lice, drain moths, fruit flies, pavement ants, little black ants, norway rats, house mice, bottle flies, house flies and mosquitos (aedes).
● Designed and recommended IPM programs for various jail facilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Integrated Pest Management · Consulting · Site Inspections · Communication · Troubleshooting · Government · Problem Solving

positions.title: Exterminator
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
● Drove city vehicles to treatment sites and collected information, performed IPM practices to reduce mosquito breeding conditions and sites, collected information regarding mosquito habitats.
● Formed part of the rodent control unit in order to treat catch basins, tree pits and other properties for norway rats, roof rats and extreme cases of house mice.
● Conducted inspections to confirm or deny the prescence or abscence of pest populations at sites throughout the city.
positions.insights: Skills: Integrated Pest Management · Site Inspections · Communication · Pest Control · Data Collection · Government · Problem Solving

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
● Implemented IPM practices to successfully control pests. In commercial and residential. 
● Set appointments, educated clients and provided customer service in English, Spanish & Portuguese. 
● Mixed restricted use pesticides within the parameters of the labels for application.
● Assisted restaurants to get a passing grade from the DOHMH through 
instruction, inspection and treatment as necessary. Helped landlords to get in compliance with the HPD and DOHMH via instruction, inspection and treatment as required by law.
● Placed Purchase orders and recevied equipment/supplies for pest management 
● Received shipments and ensured that the proper equipment/supplies were received and stored correctly.
● Managed and maintained stockroom
● Distributed supplies and equipment to technicians, logged equipment usage and condition 
● Kept accurate inventory count, ordered supplies and equipment, replenished shelves 
● Utilized diagrams and schematics to repair equipment (wands, tanks, fans) 
● Made over-the-counter sales and phone sales to customers in English, Spanish and Portuguese. 
● Made equipment/supply usage reports and created lead analysis reports 
● Created and modified material request forms for accurate record keeping
● Mixed restricted use pesticides within the parameters of the labels for application.
● Compared prices between different wholesale retailers to ensure the best price
● Researched Pesticides and equipment for efficacy and pilot progroms
positions.insights: Skills: Account Management · Integrated Pest Management · Certified Pesticide Applicator · Communication · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Supervisory Skills · Problem Solving
